summary: Explicit balance-sheet presentation categories for the statement package (PR C). report_categories / account_report_map accept statement 'balance_sheet' with sections asset / liability / equity (revenue / expense stay income-statement only). account_report_map gains approval_status ('proposed' | 'approved', default 'approved' so every existing income-statement mapping keeps its meaning), approved_by and approved_at; an approved balance-sheet mapping must say who approved it and when. approve_account_report_map() approves proposals as they stand (service_role only); set_account_report_category() records the assigning person as the approver. statement_mapping_overrides holds an owner's written decision to finalize a board statement that still has unmapped balance-sheet accounts, bound to the statement snapshot sha256; append-only. Changes no existing row; seeds nothing.

preflight.name: the CHECKs being replaced carry their default names (463 inline)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE (conrelid = 'report_categories'::regclass AND conname IN ('report_categories_statement_check', 'report_categories_section_check')) OR (conrelid = 'account_report_map'::regclass AND conname = 'account_report_map_statement_check')

preflight.name: every existing category and mapping is income-statement with a revenue / expense section
preflight.sql: SELECT ((SELECT count(*) FROM report_categories WHERE statement <> 'income_statement' OR section NOT IN ('revenue', 'expense')) + (SELECT count(*) FROM account_report_map WHERE statement <> 'income_statement'))::int

preflight.name: account_report_map has no approval columns yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'account_report_map' AND column_name IN ('approval_status', 'approved_by', 'approved_at')

preflight.name: statement_mapping_overrides does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'statement_mapping_overrides'

preflight.name: board_packets exists (the override's packet FK)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'board_packets'

expected_changes: Replaces report_categories_statement_check (income_statement, balance_sheet) and report_categories_section_check (revenue / expense for the income statement; asset / liability / equity for the balance sheet), and account_report_map_statement_check (income_statement, balance_sheet). Same names.

Adds account_report_map.approval_status (NOT NULL DEFAULT 'approved', CHECK proposed / approved), approved_by, approved_at. Existing rows read 'approved' through the column default; no row is updated.

Replaces account_report_map_validate() (balance-sheet account types; an approved balance-sheet mapping records who and when) and set_account_report_category() (same signature and return keys; the assigner is the approver). Adds approve_account_report_map(uuid, uuid[], text, text), EXECUTE to service_role only.

Creates statement_mapping_overrides (community, optional board packet, section key, snapshot sha256, unmapped accounts, reason 10+ characters, owner actor, created_at). FKs RESTRICT; index on snapshot_sha256; a guard trigger refuses UPDATE and DELETE. RLS on; nothing for anon / authenticated; SELECT, INSERT to service_role.
No report_categories, account_report_map or chart_of_accounts row changes.

verify.name: the statement CHECKs allow balance_sheet
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname IN ('report_categories_statement_check', 'account_report_map_statement_check') AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%balance_sheet%'

verify.name: every existing mapping reads approved (column default, no update)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM account_report_map WHERE approval_status <> 'approved'

verify.name: overrides are append-only (guard trigger present)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'trg_statement_mapping_overrides_guard'

verify.name: no override written; no balance-sheet category or mapping seeded
verify.sql: SELECT ((SELECT count(*) FROM statement_mapping_overrides) + (SELECT count(*) FROM report_categories WHERE statement = 'balance_sheet') + (SELECT count(*) FROM account_report_map WHERE statement = 'balance_sheet'))::int

verify.name: service_role can read and insert overrides and approve mappings; anon and authenticated cannot
verify.sql: SELECT (CASE WHEN has_table_privilege('service_role', 'statement_mapping_overrides', 'SELECT') AND has_table_privilege('service_role', 'statement_mapping_overrides', 'INSERT') AND NOT has_table_privilege('anon', 'statement_mapping_overrides', 'SELECT') AND NOT has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'statement_mapping_overrides', 'SELECT') AND has_function_privilege('service_role', 'approve_account_report_map(uuid, uuid[], text, text)', 'EXECUTE') AND NOT has_function_privilege('anon', 'approve_account_report_map(uuid, uuid[], text, text)', 'EXECUTE') AND NOT has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'approve_account_report_map(uuid, uuid[], text, text)', 'EXECUTE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int
